outcomes.rule_text: alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"ET SCAN Potential Port Scan Detected"; detection_filter:track by_src, count 60, seconds 300; classtype:network-scan; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert http $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"ET WEB_SPECIFIC_APPS Gobuster Directory Brute Force User-Agent"; flow:established,to_server; http.user_agent; content:"gobuster/3.8.2"; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 30, seconds 300; classtype:web-application-attack; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"ET SCAN Potential Port Scan Detected"; flags:S,12; detection_filter:track by_src, count 60, seconds 300; classtype:network-scan; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert http $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"ET WEB_SPECIFIC_APPS Gobuster Directory Brute Force Attempt"; flow:established,to_server; http.user_agent; content:"gobuster/3.8.2"; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 1, seconds 300; classtype:web-application-attack; sid:1000000; rev:1;)
